source.import_policy: Independently summarized facts and pinned links only; no upstream source, binary, ZIP or carrier XML imported.

local_baseline.scope: Desktop presentation and offline research only.

applied.summary: Explain the six existing allowlisted incoming_diagnostics fields in check details and support summaries; unknown stays unknown; no pass/fail or working-call conclusion.

experiments.observation: Starts /radio/bin/ims_rrm after DCA, provisioning and engineering-voice changes; no IMS image patch is visible in the inspected manager.
experiments.reason: Does not demonstrate that the verified Q10 can omit the ordinary-voice VoPS patch. Multiple simultaneous configuration changes prevent attributing a result to one parameter.

experiments.observation: Monitors IMS PPS and writes the Navigator indicator, with a BBM/RCP-based restoration routine.
experiments.reason: A phone UI write is outside this desktop-only change. Must verify case handling, stale status, conflicts, exit and flight mode; an indicator cannot establish call acceptance.
experiments.source_limitations: The connection test reads public PPS with case-sensitive LTE and no owned-process/current REGISTER 200 check. The off write uses the shorter on-string length, omitting the newline; PPS acceptance was not tested.

experiments.observation: Monitors LTE, SIM and data PPS; records drops and reconnection statistics.
experiments.reason: Useful for designing observability, but no additional monitoring or phone calls are introduced here. The forced-stop reconnection policy is not adopted.

experiments.observation: Upstream invokes swcryptoattach(0); the local helper invokes swcryptoattach(1).
experiments.reason: Source difference alone does not establish the argument's effect on BB10 or a Passport lifecycle fix. Existing ownership and VPN checks stay in force.

not_adopted.trigger: The data directory contains more than one carrier XML.
not_adopted.observation: find_carrier_xml returns the first matching directory entry without comparing its carrier ID with the SIM. Its fallback uses MNC, not the documented carrier ID.
not_adopted.impact: The selected CDSC XML may belong to a different operator. A separate carrier-ID resolver used for provisioning does not correct this selection.
not_adopted.local_policy: Read the current SIM's stock carrier selection, validate data APN, replace only its IMS section.

not_adopted.trigger: The provisioning and preconditions observations satisfy incoming_ready_pps.
not_adopted.observation: This function checks two configuration observations, not a real incoming call.
not_adopted.impact: Its INCOMING_READY label cannot establish ringing, answering or two-way audio.

not_adopted.trigger: Enable writes configuration and then fails or the manager receives a termination signal.
not_adopted.observation: The manager writes several DCA sources and provisioning XML. The inspected exit paths do not restore these settings, remove owned VPN state or unregister the provider.
not_adopted.impact: Manager exit does not prove baseline restoration; deployment-specific cleanup outside these paths has not been verified.
not_adopted.local_policy: Retain the journal, conflict detection, owned-state cleanup and readback; keep Passport recovery restricted.

not_adopted.trigger: The monitor changes from ready to not ready after loss of LTE, SIM readiness or cellular data; or a reconnect is attempted.
not_adopted.observation: The monitor calls stop_ims; reconnect also stops IMS without a fresh call-idle check. The stop helper matches a command-line substring and can escalate from SIGTERM to SIGKILL.
not_adopted.impact: Could interrupt a surviving call/session or an IMS instance not owned by this manager. Source inspection does not prove that this happens on every device.
not_adopted.local_policy: Keep runtime transient LTE recovery with native IMS and preserve narrowly verified startup handoff.

acceptance_limits: Carrier templates do not establish hardware/network support.
No new call, restart, long-call, long-standby, flight-mode or provider-lifecycle evidence was collected.
Unverified combinations remain manual-start only; Passport automatic operations remain restricted.
